payload.title: Image toolchain step 1b: Image types in the operation table
payload.description:
Build step 1b of the image toolchain (design: project/wiki/image-toolchain.md, section 9). Revised 2026-11-07 for named image types.

(small follow-up to merged PR 1). The edits in 3.7: `imageType` on resolve, brief, prompt preview, search, generate and apply; `imageTypes` and `spread: types`; examples belong to a type; `image_figure_add`; three new errors; rerun the generator. Handlers still `not_implemented`.

Specs: `image-operations.feature` rerun; new examples show `imageType`; parity holds for `image_figure_add`.

What deploys: Nothing.

Fulfils or changes: Amends PR 1.

Gherkin specs are required. Style guidance is data, never code. Spending is only approved for step 6.
